tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i sku bzhengs tshul yid bzhin nor bu mthong ba rang grol bzhugs so// na mo gu ru a nan+da puṇ+yā/ na maḥshrī ma hā kā la ya/ 'dir dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i sku 'bag bzhengs pa'i tshul cung zad rang gi dran gso'i tshul du bri bar bya'o/ /de la thog mar ljin pa la sogs pa'i rgyu dang / sku ji tsam pa bzhengs pa'i tshad kyi srog shing gri lcags seng ldeng la sogs pa gang 'byor pa rnams 'dus byas la/ mgon po'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa byas nas srog shing dang rgyu de la zhi ba/ zhi drag phyed pa/ drag po'i sbyang ba rnams rab gnas ltar bya/ tshig lhug pa brjod dus/ 'dir rdo rje nag po chen po'i sku bzhengs su gsol ba'i srog shing dang / rgyu byin gyis rlobs pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad gtor ma lam rngan ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig ces brjod nas khro bo spyan 'dren sogs byed/ drag po'i skabs su'ang 'dis rigs 'gre shes so/ /drag po'i dus rol mo drag tu byed/ gu gul dang mgon po'i sbyar spos yod na des srog shing dang rgyu rnams bdugs/ yungs kar gyis khrab/ shā sa na bzlas so/ /de nas srog shing dang rgyu de'i mthar ci 'byor pa'i mchod gtor bshams/ thun mong ba'i bsrung 'khor bsgom la/ srog shing dang rgyu rnams a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dbus su dgra bgegs thams cad mnan pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba khro bo'i rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa kha gyes shing gdengs pa'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros sogs dam tshig pa bskyed pa/ ye shes pa gzhug pa/ dbang bskur mi bskyod pa'i dbu brgyan pa/

dam bzhag gtor ma phul nas phrin las bcol ba sogs gtor bsngos dkrus bzhin las/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab sgrub thabs bzhin no/ /de ltar tshar ba dang srog shing la su pra tiṣ+ṭhas brtan bzhugs dang / rgyu'i dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa rnams gnyis su med par thim zhing 'dres pas rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa ye shes lnga'i ngo bo rgyu phun sum tshogs pa zhig tu gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ phur pa kye rdor gang rigs nas bshad pa ltar gyi cho gas tshogs rgyas par bya/ srog shing 'dzugs pa 'di dag ni nyer dgu la nges par legs so/ /bzo bo ni bla med kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i gang zag de rdo rje rigs khro bo mgon po sogs gang yang rung ba'am/ bgegs mthar byed du skad cig gis bskyed/ g.yon phyogs su yum re bsam mo/ /bzo bo de gur gyi mgon po sogs lam nyams su len bzhin pa yin na ma bskyed kyang rung ngo / /de'i phyag g.yas thabs kyi ngo bo rdo rje/ g.yon shes rab kyi ngo bo pad+ma bsgom la/ thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i sgo nas las thams cad byed par bsam la rus shing 'dzugs pa sogs rim gyis byed do/ /sku che rab yod na/ zhabs g.yas g.yon gnyis su phur pa ji ltar rigs pa rtse'i dbal zur gsum la bod rbad bsad gsum bris nas rtser mā ra ya phaṭa yod pa byas la zhabs mthil gnyis nas phyir 'thog pa liṅga'i snying khar bzhugs pa yin/ gang na srog shing dang phur bu'i rgyu rab mi khyi rta sogs sems can mang du bsad pa'i gri lcags las byed/ de ma 'byor na tsan dan seng ldeng sogs nas byed/ de'ang ma 'byor na shing ji ltar rigs pa la byed/ 'on kyang som dben shing yin/ glang ma 'byung po'i bla shing yin pas mi bya'o/ /sku chung ngu la chur ba mi thub pas chad pa'i skyon med/ sku'i skyar gso tshar ba dang gong gi srog shing byin rlabs ji lta ba bzhin gyi cho gas brtan bzhugs sogs kyi rab gnas tshogs 'khor sogs byed/

'on kyang sbyang ba ma grub kyang 'gal ba med do/ /de tshar ba dang gzungs gzhug byed de/ de la thog mar rgyu byin rlabs kyi skabs su/ gzungs kyi bri gzhi sogs kyang byin rlabs byed pa gzungs kyi rgyu yin no/ /bri gzhi ni gos dar nag po'am/ ma 'byor na shog bu nag po la yang rung / bla rdo rdo cho long gsum brtsegs brgyab/ bri rdzas ni gser dngul mtshal rnams gang 'byor gyi bri/ de la bla ma gong ma yid ches kyi shang mtshal dang gdung rus brtul ma cung zad bsre/ ma 'byor na'ang chad pa'i skyon med/ khyad par gyi rdzas khyim pa'i chos kyi ma gos pa'i bu mo gzhon nu ma'i mngal khrag 'di rang byung gi me tog yang yin/ gu gul nag po/ dpa' bo g.yul du bsad pa'i gri khrag tshil chen rnams cung zad bsre bas na yi ge bri ba'i thum/ khyad par gyi rdzas de rnams yid ches 'byor na rab/ rtogs ldan rdzun po che 'di 'dra'i lag nas byung ba'i yin nam snyam pa'i yid mi ches bzhin du bsre ba ni/ bstan pa bsrung ba'ang dngos 'di 'dra ba'i nang rdzas byed rgyu yin pas bar chad du'ang / song nyan yod pas ma bsres pa legs par mngon no/ /bri tshul ni/ bri gzhi la thog mar mgon po lha brgyad kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan 'bru gsum dang spel ba bri/ de'i rjes la aṣ+ṭa/ de wa pi tsu/ karta ri rnams bri/ de nas oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu ni shākya mu ni ye swāhā/ zhes de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dang / oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā li de wī ye/ badz+ra kā la yak+ṣa/ badz+ra kā li yak+ṣi ṇi/ badz+ra yak+ṣa pu tra/ badz+ra ru tra bha ṭa/ badz+ra ru lu rak+kha si sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya sma ra si/ sa ma ya mā ti kra ma tha/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam bral bran g.yog bka' bstod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig bsrung /

bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ khyad par du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba dang / bdag gi lam bsgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs dam nyams phyi nang gsang gsum la sogs pa log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyi 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi ba'i thabs kyi 'dul du ma 'tshal na gang la gang 'tshams pa'i chad pas bcad pa dang / skrad cing gzir ba dang / dbye ba dang / bsdigs shing dpa' skong bar mdzad du gsol/ mdor na chos bsgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du bsgrub cing / bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa dang / 'jig rten pa kun dar zhing rgyas par mdzod/ ces dang / oṃ sarba wi d+yā swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ ces pa bri/ yang bri gzhi gong du bshad pa bzhin nam/ shog bu dkar po la snag tshas bris kyang rung / pad ma yin yang 'gal ba med do/ /bri rgyu'i sngags ni phyogs skyong bcu/ rgyal chen sde bzhi/ lha chen brgyad/ gnod sbyin brgyad/ 'jigs byed dgu/ gza' dang rgyu skar rnams kyi snying po bris la mjug tu ye dharma bri'o/ /gzungs 'di rnams la gsung rab spyi dang mthun pa'i rab gnas bsdus pa bzhin byas la mgo nas bsgril/ khyad par gyi gzungs ni/ gri snying bca' thabs bzhin yin te/ de'i tshul man ngag ltar brjod na/ gong du tshags byas pa'i bla rdo rdo cho long yang zer/ 'dre cho long yang zer/ pha wang long rus zer ba'i rdo gru bzhi ngos legs pa yid du 'ong ba che chung gzungs dkris nas snying gi rtsa nang du shong ba gsum gyi nang la dregs pa gnyis med kyi sa bon steng du hūm̐ dang / 'og tu bh+yoḥbri/

gcig la dregs pa pho rgyud kyi sa bon steng du hūm̐ dang 'og tu tṛḥbri/ gcig la dregs pa mo rgyud kyi sa bon steng du bh+yoḥdang 'og tu maṃ bri/ gong gi dar nag sogs kyi bri gzhi gcig la bshad pa ltar kyi bri rdzas kyi mgon po'i yi ge bcu gnyis ma/ bdun ma/ sha sa na rnams dang / oṃ e ka dza ṭi de ba in+d+ra si hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ ces pa bris pa'i mjug tu gsham bu 'di yang bri dgos te/ 'dod don gyi skabs su rang rang gi skabs dang bstun nas rigs 'gre shes par bya'o/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po/ yum chen e ka dza ṭi 'khor dang bcas pa rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas/ dben gnas byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong 'di nyid kyi bsrung ma mdzad nas sa skya pa'i bsgom chen 'dres med rgyun mi chad par 'byung zhing de rnams kyi sa lam gyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi nas/ nang gi rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas te myur du rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phangs thob pa dang / de dag gis kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad pa'i phrin las dam pa mdzod cig spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan 'dzin gyi skye bu dam pa rnams kyi sku tshe dang / mdzad pa phrin las kyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las 'gro don dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang / dge 'dun gyi sde rnams 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams su bde legs bsam gyi mi khyab pa rgya chen po 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod cig khyad par du yang dpal ldan sa skya'i dgon gnas mi nyams shing gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang / dben gnas 'di nyid dang / gdan sa chen po sa skyar gnas pa rnams kyang phan tshun byams pa'i sems dang ldan zhing nga rgyal 'gran sems phrag dog

dbyen skyo ba/ dkrug bcol sogs mi dge ba'i phyogs kun zhi nas bstan pa'i yang snying rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi nyams len rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab lhad med phyin ci ma log pa mu mtha' med pa la thos bsam bsgom gsum gyi sgo nas chos tshul bzhin du rnam par dag pa byed mkhan 'byung ba dang / de rnams kyi 'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen thams cad 'bad med du 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod/ bye brag tu yang rnal 'byor pa ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsam don thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub cing / sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'byung ba dang / de dag gis kyang sa skya pa'i bstan pa 'dres med rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang / thos bsam bsgom gsum gyi sgo nas sa skya pa'i bstan pa rnal ma lhad med 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / sa skya'i dgon gnas 'di nyid mi nyams shing gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i thabs kho na byed cing nus pa phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod cig spyir yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad du lo legs shing skya rgyal ba mi nad phyugs nad thams cad rgyun chad cing mi 'byung ba/ dus kyi 'khrugs pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba/ khyad par du dpal ldan sa skya 'di nyid du mi la na tsha/ phyugs la god kha/ zhing la sad ser ba/ 'bu than pa/ kha ba la sogs pa'i lo dgra thams cad de/ mdor na 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i rkyen thams cad las bsrung ba dang / mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams/ dpal dang 'byor pa snyan grags thams cad dang chos dang mthun pa'i bsam pa chen po la sogs pa legs pa'i yon tan gyi phyogs thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod cig spyir rgyal ba'i bstan pa bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs smod pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde dkrug pa/ skye 'gro yongs kyi bde skyed 'joms shing sems can yongs la 'tshe ba/

khyad par bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i sde dang bstan par gtogs pa rnams la/ bsam pa ngan pa/ sbyor ba rtsub par byed pa'i sgo nas/ do bdo ba/ phod 'dzugs pa'i gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa'i dam nyams phyi nang gsang gsum sa 'og sa steng sa bla gang na gnas pa thams cad myur du tshar bcad nas rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su bskyal nas 'jig rten gyi khams su gnas pa thams cad rdzogs ldan gyi dus bzhin bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod cig sa ma ya sma ra si/ sa ma ya mā ti kra ma tha/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ maṅga la/ yastu sarba dza ga taṃ/ ces pa rnams bris pa gnyis med kyi gzungs dang / bri gzhi gcig la gnod sbyin yab/ pu tra/ bha ṭa ste pho'i bod rbad bsad gsum bris pa'i rjes la/ bdud dang mu stegs ma lus pa rnams 'joms shing gsang sngags skyong bar mdzad pa'i gnod sbyin yab/ dam nyams phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dgra bgegs thams cad myur du tshar gcod par byed cing / khams gsum srog dbugs kyi bdag po las mkhan pu tra chen po/ dgra bgegs kyi snying rtsa dmar po spar bas 'don cing / dam nyams sgrol bar mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed bha ṭa nag po 'khor dang bcas pa zhes pa nas sarba dza ga taṃ gyi bar gyi gsham bu gong bzhin bris pa pho rgyud kyi gzungs dang / yang bri gzhi gcig la lha mo'i ro ru dang / gnod sbyin yab yum/ sring mo ste mo'i bod rbad bsad gsum bris pa'i mjug tu pho'i bod rbad bsad gsum bris pa'i mjug tu/ 'dod khams ma lus pa zil gyis gnon cing 'dod khams kyi bdag mo/ mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtso mo/ srid pa gsum la dbang bsgyur ba'i dpal ldan lha mo re pa ti/ ma mo mkha' 'gros sha za ma lus pa dbang du bsdus nas rnal 'byor pa rnams bu sdug bzhin du skyong zhing /

dgra bo'i snying khrag zhal du gsol ba'i dam can gnod sbyin yab yum/ bstan pa'i dgra bo thams cad bsreg par mdzad cing / gdug pa can rnams rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzad nas rgyu ma gron mo zhal du gsol ba'i sring mo khrag mig ma 'khor dang bcas pa zhes pa nas sarba dza ga taṃ zhes pa'i bar gyis gong bzhin gsham bu bris pa mo brgyud kyi gzungs te/ de rnams dang gong gi bla rdo gsum zangs gzhong la sogs pa'i gzhi bzang por 'bru nag sogs gcal du bkram pa'i steng du bzhag gzhan yang bri gzhi gnyis la las mgon gyi bod rbad bsad gsum bris la 'byor na lcags kyi phur bu gru gsum pa gnyis su bcug ma 'byor na'ang skyon med pas gzungs gnyis po'ang zangs gzhong du ma nor bar bzhag go /de'i ji ltar rigs par mchod gtor ci 'byor pa bsham/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ nang mchod sogs 'du bya'o/ /de nas rang nyid mgon po'i bdag bskyed bsdus pa cig nyams su blang nas rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod bzung la gtor/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ mi ro dmar ser mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du sogs gtor chog bzhin lha brgyad 'khor bcas yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ dbang bskur tshul sgrub thabs bzhin las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ 'khor rnams la gtso bos dbu brgyan no/ /de nas gtor ma phul/ mchod bstod rgyas bsdus gang rigs byas la/ de'i rjes su dpal rdo rje nag po chen po/ yum chen e ka dza ti/ dpal 'dod khams kyi bdag mo/ dam can gnod sbyin yab yum/ bka' stod pu tra ming sring 'khor dang bcas pa rnams rten 'di la sogs 'byung ba'i gnod pa ma byung gi bar du brtan par bzhugs nas spyir rgyal ba'i bstan pa bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs smod pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde dkrug pa/

skye 'gro yongs kyi bde skyid 'joms pa/ khyad par du bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / dpal ldan sa skya'i sde dang bstan par gtogs pa rnams la bsam pa ngan pa/ sbyor ba rtsub por byed pa'i sgo nas do bdo ba/ phod 'dzugs pa'i gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa'i dam nyams phyi nang gsang gsum thams cad myur du tshar bcad nas rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su bskyal nas 'jig rten gyi khams su bde legs rgya chen po 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang / ye dharma sogs dang / su pra tiṣ+ṭha brjod cing me tog dor ba sogs lan gsum bya'o/ /de nas rten rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i gsung yig 'bru'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ zhes brjod/ rten 'di'i gong 'og gi rab gnas bsdus pa rnams zhal bsgyur ma gtogs 'di bzhin byas na yong ngo / /de nas gnyis med kyi bla rdo la gnyis med kyi gzungs kyi yi ge mgo mjug ma log par sa bon ma bris pa'i logs gcig nas 'phred la dkris/ dar skud la sogs pa'i skud pa sngo dmar gyi rgya gram du bcings/ dpa' bo g.yul du bsad pa'i gri snying rtsa gsum dang bcas pa'i nang byi ba sa brgya sa la ma rul zhing 'bu sogs kyi skyon ye ma byung ba cig gis rtsa ma rtogs pa nang thams cad rin po che sna lnga dar sna sogs kyis bskangs nas rtsa dbus ma'i nang du gzungs kyi yig mgo gri snying gi rtse mo'i phyogs su yong ba byas la bcug nas srub rin po che dang dar sna tshogs kyi bkangs nas rlu+ung mi 'chor ba'i phyir spra tshil gyis kha bcad/ gzhan gnyis byang bla rdo la dkri ba sogs nas spra tshil gyi bcad pa sogs 'dra la/ rtsa g.yas su pha rgyud kyi gzungs dar/ g.yon du mo brgyud kyi gzungs bcug go /yang gri snying ma 'byor na gri lcags las snying gzugs byas pa'i nang du dbus dang g.yas g.yon du bcug la rin po che sogs kyis bskang ngo /

/de yang ma 'byor na skud pas dkris pa gsum po de sku'i nang du gzhug tu gsol lo/ /gzungs gzhug 'bul tshul ni dbu'i nang du bla ma brgyud pa dang / yi dam kye rdo rje'i sngags/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan/ dam bzhag gi sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa'i gzungs de dang / sangs rgyas kyi ring srel dang / bla ma gong ma'i byin rlabs rten yod na bcug gdung tshwa mang rab yod na/ lte ba yan chad la khyab par bcug pas yong / gcig las med na dbu ru gzhug go /de nas thugs ka'i thad du/ gri snying sogs yod na snying rtse dbu'i phyogs su bstan la g.yas g.yon sku dang bstun nas bcug snying sogs med na thugs ka'i dbus su gnyis med kyi gzungs dang g.yas g.yon du gong bzhin pho brgyud sogs 'jug mtshams rnams dar sna rin po che sogs dang / sing du spos gang 'byor gyi bskang / lto bar phyogs skyong sogs kyi gzungs gzhug zhabs gnyis su phur bu yod na bod rbad bsad gsum bris pa'i gzungs de phur bu'i mgo la dkris/ phur bu med na gzungs gnyis pa mgo nas bsgril ba mgo mjug ma log par zhabs gnyis su bcug la bar mtshams thams cad gong bzhin dar sna sogs kyi bskangs nas mi 'chug par bya/ de nas dbu dang sku rgyab kyi bug pa bsub nas tshon gsol tshar ba dang / spyan 'byed ma grub gong du gzungs kyi rab gnas bzhin las gtso bo rkyang pa bskyed pa'o/ /pad+ma dang ro'i gdan gyi steng du shog bu'i liṅga sngags chan sngags med gang rung yang gan rkyal du bcug la 'gab bsdoms bya/ spyan 'byed pra tshil sogs tshar nas sku pad gdan la bzhugs dus mchod gtor sogs sku'i mdun du 'dus byas nas/ dpon slob rnams gral la 'khod pa la/ mgon po'i bdag bskyed bsdus pa byas/ sku de nyid bsang sbyangs byas gong ltar bskyed la rgyas gdab mi bskyod pa sogs byed/ bskyed dus gzhan 'dra la/ mi'u thung gel pa'i 'dug stangs kyi bzhugs pa'i zhabs gnyis gnam lcags las grub pa'i phur bu stod rgya mdud smad phur bu dbal gyi rnam pa can drag po'i lcags dang tsha tsha rab tu 'phro ba mgar ba'i thab nang nas ston pa ltar dmar khroṃ khroṃ 'phro zhing tsha la rtsub pa dgra bgegs kyi lus la reg pa tsam gyis 'bigs par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan zhing ro'i steng na 'gying zhing bzhugs pa sogs nas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes pa'i bar gtor chog bzhin byas/ spyan 'dren gyi tshigs bcad ni 'di ltar byed/ gu gul dang sbyar spos yod na bsregs/ rol mo'i sgra rngam brjid dang bcas shing gdung ba'i dbyangs dang ldan pa'i 'di skad brjod do/ /hūm̐ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /sogs kha khas mdzad pa'i nag po mchod rten gyi spyan 'dren sh+lau ka drug gi mjug tu/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ā sa na tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ zhes brjod cing rkang gling sogs drag tu 'bud cing rol mo chems brdung byed/ de nas pad gdan liṅga dang bcas pa gu gul gyis bdugs la de nyid a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las suṃ las rdo rje'i brag rdzong zur gsum pa stong gsum gyi tshad dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag me rab tu 'bar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du nri las gnod byed dgra bgegs lus rid pa/ skra 'dzings pa/ kha nas snying khrag dron mo skyug cing gzhan yang lus kyi bu ga dgu thams cad nas lus zungs kyi khu khrag 'dzag pa/ lus la shu ba'i phreng bas bskor ba/ bsgral ba'i zhing bcu dang ldan pa'i dgra bgegs dngos kyi rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ zhes brjod cing dmigs yul yod na/ de'i bzhin la sogs pa gsal bar bsgom pas dmigs pa gsal na don 'grub pa lags/ de nas slob dpon gyi rdo rje dril bu 'dzin cing hūm̐ mdzad kyis phyag rgya bcas la/ ngag tu/ dzaḥn mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi༞ chos kyi༞ dge 'dun gyi༞ bcom ldan 'das kye rdo rje la sogs pa'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ khyad par du dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' stod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa/ yum chen sring mo bzhi la sogs pa rdo rje'i chos skyong ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi༞

chos nyid rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag cing / chos can las 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag rnams dang / khyad par du rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad skad cig nyid la gzugs dang liṅga 'di la mchis par gyur cig oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya sarba sha trun bigh+nān ā kar+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya mā ra ya hūm̐/ ces pa'i dgug gzhug lan gsum dang / log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad ces pa yan gong bzhin la/ skyob par byed pa'i lha dang / 'go bar byed pa'i lha dang / bsrung bar byed pa'i lha thams cad phrol cig oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya sarba sha trun bigh+nān/ sarba de wa rāk+ṣa bi de shi ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas lha dbye byas nas/ rnga brdeg bdun brdung gsum dang / 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /nag po khyod ni yin pa ste/ /gdug pa tshar gcod 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /ral pa kham pa gyen du rdzes/ /steng gi lha tshogs 'jigs par byed/ /spyan bgrad ljags 'dril bar gdon sdigs/ /g.yas pa gri gug dgra srog gcod/ /g.yon pas gdug pa khrag bskang gsol/ /zhabs brdabs gnod sems can lus nyed/ /gang zhig dkon mchog gsum gnod dang / bla ma brnyas byed sems can 'tshe/ /bdag gi bsgo ba kun khug la/ /liṅga 'di la myur du chug /'di yi sha zo khrag la 'thung / /rus pa klad pa nang khrol zo/ /rigs brgyud rtsad nas chod las shog /mdza' ba kun dang phrol las shog /bdag gi bsgo ba ma nyan na/ /nag po khyod ni nyams par 'gyur/ /ces dang / dpal ldan mgon po nag po khyod/ /sogs nas/ da lta nyid du grub par mdzod/ /ces pa'i bar dam pa'i bskangs gso nag pa mchod rten ma'i nang bzhin brjod cing /

rol mo drag tu brdungs/ shā sa na dang bod rbad bsad gsum brjod/ mgon po'i sku ro gdan steng du bsgrigs nas brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /dmigs pa ni/ rang gi gang dmigs pa'i dgra bo de'i snying khar mgon po'i zhabs kyi phur bus btab/ las mkhan rnams kyi mtshon cha sna tshogs pas dgra bgegs kyi lus thams cad dum bur bstubs/ rnam shes chos dbyings su bskyal bar bsam mo/ /de nas dgra bgegs kyi sha rus dang / gtor chung de oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin rlabs dran par byas/ shā sa na tshar lnga la sogs pa'i gtor sngags kyis phul/ phrin las bcol bstod pa bsdus pa zhig byas la/ de nas sang rab gnas rgyas pa bya ba'i yo byad mnga' dbul gyi gdan la sogs pa dang / chos skyong bsgo ba'i gtor ma shin tu che zhing rgyan dang ldan pa/ mchod gtor sogs thun mong ba rab gnas spyi dang mthun pa rgya che ba dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i gtor ma nag po mchod rten nas bshad pa bzhin dmar nag zur gsum du byas pa la rtse mor mar gyi me tog gam sbab le/ de'i steng du thod pa khrag dang / de'i steng du gri gug yu ba la rdo rje rtse gdengs pa/ de'i steng du nor bu 'bar ba ci legs kyi gzugs kyis brgyan/ gtor ma'i mtha' la me ris mam sas yang brgyan pa la/ steng du mkha' lding / g.yas su bya nag g.yon du khyi nag rgyab phyogs su ce spyang / mdun du mi nag gi gzugs zan nag la bzos nas/ smyug gtsang dang bcas pa dang sha gtsang ma yang gzug go /gzhan yang zhal dang / lha mo/ pu tra sogs la bskang gso byed nas/ skye 'gro'i gzungs tsam ma gtogs gong bzhin dang / gtor ma rnams kyi mjug tu yang / thod pa'am ting la sogs pa'i nang du dmigs nas bsad pa ma yin pa'i khrag la 'byor na gri khrag btab pa'i mchod yon dang / de bzhin du dbang po lnga'i me tog dngos sam zan la bcos pa/ tshil chen la sogs pa'i bdug spos sam sha chen skam po ji ltar rigs pa bzhag

snum la zhu chen bsres pa'i mar me/ 'khris chen gyi dri chab/ sha chen btab pa'i zhal zas bshos bu dmar po ste/ de rnams kyi rdzas rnams 'byor na dpa' bo g.yul du bsad pa'i sha chen sogs yin no/ /ma 'byor na de dang der mos pa bya'o/ /de nas dpon slob rnams kyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ ḍā ma ru/ nang mchod rnams dang / gzhan yang rnga sil snyan/ dung gu gul/ byon skyems sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med par 'dus byas la rnal 'byor pa rnams gral la 'khod nas/ gtor chung gcig long gcig tu chu chang gis sbyangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ/ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i ma ཾga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ne daṃ ba l+yā di swahā/ lan gsum brjod/ rnga brdungs shing 'das dang ma byon gyi dbyangs bcug la/ gang gi 'byung po mthu chen dang / /sems can la 'tshe bstan la gnod/ /bsgrub la bar du gcod pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kun nyon cig /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje che/ /bgegs kyi steng na mthu stobs mchog /gal te bka' las 'da' byed na/ /rdo rje 'bar bas 'joms par byed/ /de bas sngon gyi dam tshig bzhin/ /byin gyi rlabs pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /dwang ba'i tshul gyis rab khyer la/ /ci bde bar ni gzhan du dengs/ /sarba bigh+nān gats+tsha ces dang / shā sa na brjod gtor ma phyir dor ro/ /de nas gnas dang mdun gyi mchod pa rnams la dmigs nas/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang 'di nyid drag po'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che bar hūm̐ las byung ba'i phyi nang gi dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag gi mchod yon/ dbang po lnga'i me tog tshil chen gyi bdug spos/ zhu chen gyi sgron me/ 'khris pa'i dri chab/

sha rus kyi zhal zas/ dung chen gyi gling bu sogs rol mo'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gi b.rabarjod cing rol mo dkrol/ dharma ra ṇi lan gsum brjod/ de nas spro na zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad bya/ mi spro na ma byas kyang 'gal ba med/ de nas skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te dkyil 'khor bsdus nas rang he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sku can du gyur pa'i bar lam dus dkyus bzhin byas nas bum bzlas bya ba/ rten sbyangs bkru zhing phyi ba/ ring srel gzhug cing gsol ba gdab pa rnams gzhung bzhin/ rten bskyed pa'i skabs su a mṛ tas bsangs/ shū n+yā tas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma/ mi ro dmar ser mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po chen po cher 'bar ba nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar gtor chog bzhin la mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can dor ro/ /lha mo la sogs lha brgyad tshang ma yod dam sku du yod kyang gtor chog gam rang gi gzhung bzhin bskyed/ de dag gi dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma'i steng du āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po zhes byin gyi rlabs so/ /spyan 'dren pa dang dgug pa gzhung bzhin grub rjes/ khyad par gyi spyan 'dren ni/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ bka' bsrung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa sprin spungs 'thib pa ltar spyan drangs par bsam zhing /

gu gul sha chen sogs kyi dud pa cher bya/ 'byor na chos skyong gi sbyar spos yang bsregs/ rol mo'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa slob ma rnams kyi bya/ slob dpon gyi g.yas rdo rje me tog dang bcas/ g.yon dril bu sil/ las kyi rdo rjes rkang gling kha phyogs bzhir ltas 'bud cing g.yab dar yang g.yob/ de nas rnga tshigs rdzogs pa dang / dpon slob rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad brjod/ hūm̐ rdo rje 'chang dang mkha' 'gro rdo rje gur/ /bram ze mchog srid bde ba'i rdo rje dang / /shrar+dha ka ra warma rin chen bzang / /yon tan tshul khrims la sogs gshegs su gsol/ /blo gros grags dang rje btsun sa skya pa/ /bsod nams rtse mo grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / /sa skya paṇa chen 'phags pa rin po che/ /dam pa kun grags la sogsྎ /bdag nyid chen po bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa/ /bla chen kun rgyal nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang / /rgya gar shes bzang 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma 'khor bcasྎ /yang na dam pa'i rjes su/ kun dga' bsod nams rin chen rgyal mtshan dang / /bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims pa/ /ye shes rgyal mtshan kun dga' bzang po'i mtshan/ /dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la sogs gshegs su gsol/ /kun dga' dbang phyug bsod nams seṅge'i mtshan/ /'dren mchog dam pa dkon mchog 'phel ba'i zhabs/ /'jam dbyangs sa lo kun dga'i mtshan can sogs/ /rtsa rgyud bla ma 'khor bcasྎ /brgyud pa gnyis po gang rung gi rjes la 'di bya ste/ bla ma mchog dang yi dam lha tshogs kyi/ /rjes bzung gdams pa zab mos rab brgyan zhing / /ting 'dzin nus pas chos bsrung bran 'khol ba'i/ /de 'dra'i bla ma gang bzhugs gnas nas gshegs/ /chos sku mkha' khyab pho brang chen po nas/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes gang 'dul skur ston cing / /bka' gsang rmad du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog /yi dam kye rdor la sogs gshegs su gsol/

/zhes dang / dam pa'i bskang gso nag po mchod rten ma'i spyan 'dren/ hūm̐ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad sh+lau ka gsum brjod/ lha mo sogs yod na skabs su gang bab kyi spyan 'dren gyi tshig brjod/ de nas rol mo chems brdung dang rkang gling sogs kyi sgra cher byed cing / slob dpon gyi rten la nas gtor/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥshrī he badz+ra ya/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ces pas spyan drangs shing bstim/ de nas/ hūm̐/ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i gzhal yas dam pa 'dir/ /dam tshig can gyi rnal 'byor bdag cag rnams/ /dam rdzas mchod gtor 'dod yon sna tshogs kyi/ /thugs dam bskang phyir brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /ro bcud brgya ldan gser skyems gtsang ma dang / /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i rak+ta'i mchod yon 'di/ /dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /byon skyems dam par 'bul gyis dges par rol/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra a sa na tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ ces pa dang / chang dang khrag gtsang ma bsres pa'i phud gtor/ de dag gis ni brtan bzhugs dang byon skyems phul la/ rgyas gdab pa ni/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po āḥyis mtshan pa/ thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa zhes brjod cing bsam/ dbang bskur ba ni/ slar yang rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ khro bo bcu/ lha mo drug dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dkar mo ri dwags kyis mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rjes bstod/ byang chub rdo rjes dbang bskur bar gsol ba lan gsum btab nas rang slob dpon gyi mdun du stegs kyi steng du dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa dang las bum/

dbu rgyan/ rdo rje dril bu/ nang mchod rnams bzhag go /de nas las bum gyi chu gtor/ oṃ swa bhā wa brjod/ rten dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs kyi gnyis ka mi bskyod pa kye rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa'am/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum dang bcas par bskyed/ skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyi rlabs/ ye shes pa gzhug oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs gsol ba btab cing / dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ rgyas gdab/ dbang rdzas kyi lha zhu ba las dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur zhes brjod cing bsam nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyi rnam rgyal bum pa bteg nas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /sogs brjod cing rten la dbang bskur tshul byas/ las kyi slob mas rten gyi drung du stegs kyi steng du ting la sogs pa'i snod du bum chu ji ltar rig pa blug nas slar bum pa slob dpon gyi mdun du bzhag go /rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab/ mchod pa lngas mchod/ rtogs bskyed do/ /de bzhin du rin 'byung man la'ang cho ga'i chings 'dra/ dbang bskur sogs slob dpon gyi dbang bskur tshul dang / las kyi slob mas stegs kyi steng du bsgrig brtul zhugs la slob dpon rang nyid kyi mdun na yod pa'i rdo rje blangs nas 'bul tshul byed/ yang slob dpon gyi dbang don du gsol ba btab ni mi dgos/ 'di de sogs dang rdo rje'i brtul zhugs ltar rdo rje 'bul tshul dang / de bzhin du dril bu'ang 'bul tshul bya'o/ /rig pa'i dbang lnga brtul zhugs dang drug rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang rnams kyi rtogs bskyed dor ba ma gtogs tshig rnams lam dus kyi dbang bzhin/ 'on kyang rgyas par byed na rigs lnga sogs zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug par skyed pa tsam yin te/

phyag len la zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mdzad do/ /de nas dbang lha'i gtso bo'am byang sems rten gyi ljags thog tu bzhag par mos la/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sogs brjod/ gsal stong zung 'jug gi ye shes skyes par bsam pa gsang dbang / slob dpon gyi nang mchod nas thur mas blangs te rten la 'bul tshul dang / las kyi rdo rjes rten gyi drung stegs kyi steng du snod ji ltar rigs par blug go /yang dbang lha'i thugs kha nas ye shes kyi phyag rgya sprul nas rten la gtad par bsam la/ dga' ster gnas ster sogs sh+lau ka gcig brjod bde stong zung 'jug gi skyes par bsam pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / de nas ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /sogs brjod pa dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de ltar na dbang bzhi bskur bas sogs rigs bdag gi dbu brgyan pa/ /bcu pa mchod cing bstod pa man rab gnas kyi gzhung bzhin no/ /bstod pa'i skabs su rigs lnga'i spyi bstod kyi rjes la srin gzugs ma sogs skabs dang sbyar ro/ /mnga' dbul gyi bstod pa'i skabs su srin gzugs ma sogs chos skyong gi bstod pa rnams la rnga brdungs dbyangs dang bcas pa mdzad do/ /gtor ma sbyin pa'i skabs su gtor bsngo rnams tshar ba dang / bskang rdzas byin rlabs nas brtsams te bskang gso dang bstod pa rnams phyag len bzhin byed/ tshogs yod na phud dbul zhing longs spyod/ gtor ma rnams gtang rag gi tshul du steng du phul/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma sogs mdzad pas 'og tu sleb pa dang chos skyong bsgo ba sogs mdzad do/ /'di'i skabs kyi tshig kha 'phangs pa'i rab gnas kyi gzhung ni/ snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅges mdzad pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga dge legs rgya mtshor lta bar bya'o/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i sku gzugs bzhengs tshul 'di/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gab sbas kyi tshul gyi gsal bar ma byung na'ang rang dang 'dra ba'i blo gros dman pa rnams kyi nor 'khrul byung dogs/

chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i sku bzhengs tshul dang / dam pa rin po che kun dga' grags kyi mdzad pa'i bris sku bzhengs tshul gtso bor mdzad pa rnams la gzhi byas/ gzhan yang bla ma gong ma'i man ngag yid ches pa'i gnad du ma la brten nas gsal bar bkod pa 'di ni rje btsun dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan zhing mtshan thos pa tsam gyi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las skyob par mdzad pa'i sa lo tsā ba chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / de nyid kyi thugs sras dam pa yongs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub pa dang / grub chen dpal ldan bkra shis sogs bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos gus par len pa sa skya pa ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis/ rje btsun gong ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i dben pa'i ri khrod byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong du rdo rje nag po chen po'i sku bzhengs pa'i dus yid ches pa'i rten 'brel du ma byung ba dang / phyag len gyi bsgrig char 'di rnams kyang gsal bar blo la shar nas sug bris bgyis pa 'di la nyes pa'i tshogs mchis na bla ma dang mkha' 'gros bzod par mdzod/ las 'di la brten nas bstan pa'i dgra bo thams cad tshar bcad nas/ sa skya pa'i bstan pa rnal ma mi nyams shing gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i sku bzhengs tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
